headlines.snippet: Reports from Brazil indicate Flavio Bolsonaro, who lost the presidential election, has fled the country and is heading to the US. Brazilian authorities have canceled his passport after he failed to surrender it as ordered. Argentina denies his entry, and his whereabouts remain undisclosed.
